title: Document the remote snapshot decoding boundary to prevent generic bypasses
outcome: Make the remote response decoder contract explicit at the typed snapshot wrappers and generic JSON request helpers, so future peer endpoints carrying direct or nested state snapshots use remote_summary_compat and preserve strict canonical decoding.
acceptance: Contract comments at the typed state/project/orchestrator response wrappers and generic lease-aware JSON helpers state that inbound peer snapshots, including nested snapshots, use the remote-only compatibility decoders.

The clarification preserves current decoding, lease and authority behavior; it introduces no Markdown or source-phrase pinning tests. Any structural guard is separately justified and behaviorally verified.
